join.description: Paste the invite your host sent you. It names the server and, for public servers, its certificate.
join.certChanged: The server presented a different certificate
join.certChangedHint: Only continue if your host told you they moved or rebuilt the server.

connect.description: Reaching the server named in the invite.

problems.bad_answer: That is not a Dainty Lass server
problems.cert_mismatch: The certificate does not match the invite

hints.tailscale_missing: This is a private server on a Tailscale network. Install Tailscale and accept the host's share.
hints.unreachable: It may be offline, or your network blocks it. If your host moved the server to another address or port, ask them for a new invite.
hints.bad_answer: Something answered, but not a server this launcher can join.
hints.cert_mismatch: Someone may be between you and the server. Ask your host before going further.

register.title: Pick a name
register.description: Your name on this server. The launcher keeps the account key that proves it is yours.
register.name: Player name
register.nameInvalid: Use 3 to 16 letters, digits or underscores
register.haveKey: Sign in with an existing account key
register.keyHint: Starts with DLK_. Only paste it into this launcher.

locate.title: Find your Dauntless
locate.description: You need Dauntless 1.14.7: use an install you already have, or download it from your Epic account.

problems.not_found: No Dauntless was found in that folder.
problems.unverified: The game files have not been checked yet.

titles.outdated: The game runtime has an update

hints.missing: The server's version {version} is what makes the game talk to it.
hints.untrusted: These files will load inside your game. Check they match what your host published.
hints.unavailable: Ask your host to publish the runtime.
hints.local: A runtime from a folder on this PC is in use, for testing.

task.eta: {seconds, plural, one {# second left} other {# seconds left}}

ready.title: Ready to play
ready.description: The launcher stays open while you play: it relays the game to the server.
ready.runningHint: Relaying on 127.0.0.1:{port}. Keep the launcher open.
ready.backupHint: If this PC is lost, the key is the only way back into your account.

servers.title: Servers
servers.description: Servers you have joined. Each keeps its own account key.
servers.emptyHint: Paste an invite on the Play page.
servers.removeBody: Its account key is deleted from this PC. Back it up first if you want to come back.

settings.title: Preferences
settings.streamerModeHint: Hides addresses, paths and player names on screen.
settings.hostToolsHint: Show the server manager's tools for running your own server.
settings.signOutHint: Signing out removes the account key from this PC. Without a backup the account cannot be recovered.
settings.showGameConsoleHint: Off, its lines appear under Game log instead. Applies from the next launch.

gameLog.title: Game log
gameLog.description: What the game's console shows while it runs. The account key is hidden.
gameLog.empty: Nothing yet. The game's console appears here once the game opens one.

install.title: Game management
install.description: Download Dauntless 1.14.7 from your own Epic Games account. The launcher checks every file against the archived manifest.
install.accountDescription: Sign in with the Epic account that owns Dauntless. The sign-in stays on this PC and is never sent to a server.
install.pasteHint: Open this link in your browser, sign in, and paste the code (or the whole page) it shows.
install.notOwnedHint: This account does not own Dauntless, so Epic will not serve its files.
install.locateOnly: Not on Epic any more: choose a folder you already have under Play.
install.inUse: This is the game folder the launcher uses.

manifest.unreachable: The manifest could not be downloaded. Check your connection and refresh.
manifest.invalid: The downloaded manifest does not match its pin, so it was not used.

hints.notOwned: This Epic account does not own Dauntless.

install.discardHint: What has been downloaded so far is deleted. Installing again starts from the beginning.

host.title: Host tools
host.description: Dump the SDK, build the runtime and make the game data your server runs on
host.offHint: Turn on Tools for hosts in Preferences to use this page.

jobs.inject: Starting the game with a tool

host.noWorkspace: No workspace chosen. Download the project, or choose a checkout you already have.
host.workspaceInvalid: That folder is not a Dainty Lass checkout.
host.sdkHint: Dumper-7 writes the game's C++ headers from your running 1.14.7 client. The runtime and the CatalogExporter are built against them. Never share the SDK.
host.importSdkFolderHint: A CppSDK folder you dumped by hand.
host.runtimeHint: Needs Visual Studio with C++ and Rust. Players install the published runtime from your server.
host.gameDataHint: The CatalogExporter runs inside the game and exports what the backend and the Director serve. Start the game with it, wait for the export, then generate the game data.
host.importGameDataHint: A pack exported on another PC.

inject_dumper.label: Start the game with Dumper-7
inject_dumper.hint: Loads Dumper-7 through the runtime loader. The dump appears once the game reaches the menu.

import_sdk.label: Import the newest dump
import_sdk.hint: Copies the newest dump into the runtime source.

publish_runtime.label: Publish the runtime
publish_runtime.hint: Hands the built DLLs to the content server. Players are asked to accept the new files.

build_exporter.label: Build the CatalogExporter
build_exporter.hint: Compiles the exporter against the same SDK.

inject_exporter.label: Start the game with CatalogExporter
inject_exporter.hint: Loads the CatalogExporter through the runtime loader. It writes the export while the game runs.

copy_exports.label: Copy the exports
copy_exports.hint: Brings the export from the game folder into the workspace.

generate_gamedata.label: Generate the game data
generate_gamedata.hint: Builds the backend's and the Director's data from the export. A running server needs a restart.

synthetic_data.label: Use example game data
synthetic_data.hint: The services start on the shipped examples, but nobody can play.

export_gamedata.label: Pack the game data
export_gamedata.hint: Writes a pack to move the game data to another PC.

host.requirementsHint: Checked when this page opened and after each task.

problems.service_running: Installed as a service that is already running; the kit starts its own.
